integrity: Proof and standalone checker included; observed finite exhaustive tests are documented, not treated as proof of the infinite result.
scientific_limitations: For unrestricted feedback maps on indexed q-ary length-n words with exactly two nonzero positions; not a classification of linear complexity, multiple spikes or rotation orbits. title: Exact nonlinear complexity and full complexity spectrum of two-spike periodic words
